github.description: GitHub integration — read/write files, manage PRs, issues, releases, trigger GitHub Actions workflows. Required for CI/CD automation of Ankino Youth Hub.

filesystem.description: Filesystem access scoped to this project root. Allows reading/writing all project files during development and CI/CD operations.

memory.description: Persistent in-session memory. Stores architectural decisions, open issues, and CI/CD context across conversations. Useful for tracking the Ankino Hub build progress.

sequential-thinking.description: Enhanced multi-step reasoning for complex debugging, architecture decisions, and CI/CD pipeline troubleshooting.

_project.name: ankino-youth-hub
_project.description: Kenyan youth tech hub SPA — Vite + Vanilla JS + GSAP + Canvas API. AI chatbot (brain.js), Safaricom/M-PESA knowledge base, opportunities board, startup showcase, events calendar.

_setup_instructions.step1: Install GitHub MCP: npx @modelcontextprotocol/server-github (needs GITHUB_TOKEN env var)
_setup_instructions.step5: Add GITHUB_TOKEN to environment: export GITHUB_TOKEN=your_token
_setup_instructions.step6: Reload Cline / Claude Desktop for servers to activate
_setup_instructions.note: All servers use npx -y so they auto-install on first run. No separate install step needed.
